description: This file implements the 'shared_fd' class and related functions for managing file descriptors, including operations like copying, closing, connecting with timeout, socket creation, and various system calls. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and provides abstractions for file and socket operations, including Linux-specific features.

classes.name: LocalErrno
classes.description: Helper class to preserve and restore errno during operations.

classes.name: FileInstance
classes.description: Represents an individual file descriptor with methods for various system calls and operations.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A shared pointer wrapper around FileInstance, providing static methods for socket and file operations.

classes.name: SharedFDSet
classes.description: A set of SharedFD objects used for select/poll operations.

classes.name: PollSharedFd
classes.description: Structure representing a pollable shared file descriptor.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies data from another FileInstance into this one.

methods.name: CopyAllFrom
methods.description: Copies all data from another FileInstance.

methods.name: Chmod
methods.description: Changes the permissions of the file descriptor.

methods.name: ConnectWithTimeout
methods.description: Attempts to connect with a timeout.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is set in a fd_set.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Adds the file descriptor to an fd_set.
